title: claim_classes
description: The sentence classifier's answer (Implementation Decisions 11): one class for every numbered sentence of the batch it was handed. The session sees numbers and sentences only; code maps each number back to its sentence and caches the class under research/.cache/claims.json by the sentence's hash, so a rebuild classifies only the sentences that changed.

classes.description: one entry per numbered sentence of the batch, every number exactly once

n.description: the sentence's number, exactly as the prompt printed it

class.description: claim: asserts something about the world, the data, or a result, a negative result included; definition: says what a term or a quantity means; transition: moves the reader along and asserts nothing; method_description: says what was done or how, without asserting what came of it
